documents.title: Quillon Q3 Mesh Router: Setup Guide
Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera: User Guide

questions.question: What does a solid amber light on the Q3 router mean?
questions.answer: A solid amber light means the router is powered on but has no internet connection [1].

questions.question: How long is the password reset link valid?
questions.answer: The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes [1].

questions.question: How many satellite nodes can a Q3 network have?
questions.answer: A Q3 network can support up to 6 satellite nodes in addition to the main router [1].

questions.question: What is the restocking fee for opened products?
questions.answer:
The restocking fee for opened products is 15% [1].

However, there is conflicting information regarding the return window; while Passage 1 states opened products can be returned within 14 days with this fee, Passage 5 claims any product can be returned within 60 days for a full refund. The documents do not clarify which policy applies or if the restocking fee still applies under the 60-day window mentioned in Passage 5.

questions.question: How much does Secure Family cost?
questions.answer: Secure Family costs $14.99 per month [1]. Prices are in US dollars, and annual billing offers 2 months free [1].

questions.question: How long is the warranty on refurbished products?
questions.answer: Refurbished products have a one-year limited warranty [1].

questions.question: How far does the QC2 camera's night vision reach?
questions.answer: The QC2 camera's night vision reaches up to 10 metres in complete darkness [1].

questions.question: What is the largest microSD card the QC2 camera supports?
questions.answer: The QC2 camera supports microSD cards of up to 256 GB [1]. If you encounter error code C-12, ensure you are using a card that is 256 GB or less and formatted as exFAT [3].

questions.question: How many household members can the account owner invite?
questions.answer: The account owner can invite up to 5 household members [1].

questions.question: What did firmware version 4.2.1 fix?
questions.answer: Firmware version 4.2.1 fixed the issue where devices on the guest network were disconnected every 24 hours [1]. It also improved the stability of satellite nodes after a power cut [1]. The documents do not specify what other issues, if any, this version addressed beyond these two points.

questions.question: My router's light keeps blinking red. What's going on?
questions.answer: A flashing red light indicates a hardware fault or a failed firmware update [1]. You should check the error code displayed in the app for more details [3]. If the issue is related to a failed firmware update, the router will automatically retry the update after 30 minutes; if it fails three times in a row, you should contact support [5].

questions.question: Can people on my visitor Wi-Fi see my computers and printers?
questions.answer: Yes, devices on your guest network can reach the internet but cannot see devices on your main network [1]. This means they cannot view or access your computers and printers. However, there is a discrepancy in the provided documents regarding the maximum number of devices allowed; one guide states up to 32 devices [1], while another FAQ states up to 16 devices [3].

questions.question: If I close my Quillon account, how soon is my camera footage removed?
questions.answer: Your recorded video is deleted immediately when you delete your account [5]. All other account data is deleted within 30 days [5]. The documents do not specify if this applies specifically to camera footage or only general recorded video.

questions.question: Can the indoor camera use my 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
questions.answer: No, the Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera cannot join a 5 GHz network; it connects to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only [1].

questions.question: How do I wipe everything on my mesh router and start over?
questions.answer:
To restore factory settings, press and hold the recessed reset button on the back of the router with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the light starts pulsing blue [1]. This process will erase your Wi-Fi name, password, guest network, and parental controls, requiring you to set up the router again in the app [1].

Note that the documents do not specify which button is the "recessed reset button" or provide instructions on how to access the specific setup app.

questions.question: I switched to a cheaper Secure plan. When does the change kick in?
questions.answer: Your downgrade will take effect at the start of your next billing period [1].

questions.question: Will I lose my settings if I just power cycle the router?
questions.answer: No, you will not lose your settings if you power cycle the router. Restarting keeps all of your settings [1]. However, performing a factory reset by holding the recessed button for 10 seconds will erase your Wi-Fi name, password, guest network, and parental controls [1].

questions.question: Who pays the postage when I send back something that's broken?
questions.answer: For defective products, return shipping is free [2]. If the claim is approved under the warranty, we send a replacement and provide a prepaid label for returning the faulty device [1]. For any other return where the product is not defective, the $8.95 cost of the prepaid label is deducted from your refund [2].

questions.question: E-204
questions.answer: E-204 indicates that the router did not receive an IP address from the modem. To resolve this, restart the modem first, wait two minutes, and then restart the router [1].

questions.question: What does error E-7001 mean?
questions.answer: Error E-7001 indicates that a firmware update failed its integrity check [1]. The router automatically keeps its previous firmware and will retry the update after 30 minutes. If the update fails three times in a row, you should contact support [1].

questions.question: C-12 on my camera
questions.answer: C-12 indicates that the camera does not recognize the microSD card. You should use a card of 256 GB or less and ensure it is formatted as exFAT [1]. The QC2 supports microSD cards up to 256 GB, which are inserted in the slot underneath the camera [4].

questions.question: What should I do about E-101?
questions.answer: To resolve error E-101, ensure the Ethernet cable from your modem is plugged into the yellow WAN port instead of a grey LAN port [1].

questions.question: How do I fix E-102?
questions.answer: To fix error E-102, re-enter your internet provider's PPPoE username and password under Settings, then Internet [1].

questions.question: What is error C-44?
questions.answer: Error C-44 indicates that the camera is too far from the router [1]. To fix this, you should move the camera or add a satellite node nearby [1].

questions.question: What's included in Secure Basic?
questions.answer: Secure Basic costs $4.99 per month and includes malware blocking and parental controls [1].

questions.question: What changed in firmware 4.1.3?
questions.answer:
In firmware version 4.1.3, the following changes were made:
*   A problem where the status light stayed amber after the internet connection came back was fixed [1].
*   Parental controls scheduling was improved [1].

questions.question: How much is Secure Plus, and how many cameras does its cloud video cover?
questions.answer: Secure Plus costs $9.99 per month [1]. Its cloud video history covers up to 4 cameras [1].

questions.question: What is the warranty on a new router, and does it cover damage from a power surge?
questions.answer: New Quillon products have a two-year limited warranty that covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use [3]. The warranty does not cover damage from power surges [1].

questions.question: How do I start a return, and who pays for the shipping label if the item isn't defective?
questions.answer:
To start a return, open the Quillon Home app, go to Account, then Orders, select the order, and choose Return an item [3]. You will receive a prepaid shipping label by email [3]. If the item is not defective, you must pay for the $8.95 cost of the prepaid label, which will be deducted from your refund [1].

*Note: The documents do not specify who pays for shipping if the item is defective.*

questions.question: How do I turn on two-step verification, and how many recovery codes do I get?
questions.answer: To turn on two-step verification, go to Account, then Security [1]. When you enable it, you will receive 10 one-time recovery codes that you should store somewhere safe [1].

questions.question: What do I need for a warranty claim, and can Secure Family subscribers get a replacement before sending the faulty one back?
questions.answer: To make a warranty claim, you need to contact support with your order number (or another proof of purchase) and the serial number printed on the bottom of the device [1]. Yes, Secure Family subscribers can receive an advance replacement; they get the replacement shipped before sending back the faulty device [1].

questions.question: Is there a free trial of Secure Plus, and will I be charged if I cancel before it ends?
questions.answer: Yes, every new Q3 router includes a 30-day free trial of Secure Plus [1]. You will not be charged if you cancel before the trial ends [1].

questions.question: How do I reset it?
questions.answer:
The method for resetting depends on which device you are using:

*   **For the Quillon Q3 Mesh Router:** Unplug the power adapter, wait 30 seconds, and plug it back in to restart [1]. To restore factory settings, press and hold the recessed reset button on the back with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the light pulses blue [1].
*   **For the Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera:** Press and hold the reset button underneath the camera for 5 seconds until it plays a chime [2].
*   **For your account password:** Tap "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen of the Quillon Home app and enter your email address to receive a reset link [3].

The documents do not specify how to reset other devices or provide general instructions for resetting.

questions.question: How long do I have?
questions.answer: You have 60 days to return your Quillon product for a full refund [3]. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned product [2]. If you are asking about deleting your account, that can be done immediately via the Privacy section of your Account page [4].

questions.question: How many devices are supported?
questions.answer:
The number of supported devices depends on the network type:

*   Up to 16 devices can be connected to the guest network at once [1].
*   Up to 32 devices can use the guest network at the same time [3].
*   A Q3 network supports up to 6 satellite nodes in addition to the main router [2].

The documents do not specify a total limit for all devices combined across both networks.

questions.question: Is it covered?
questions.answer: The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use for two years on new products or one year on refurbished products [3]. However, the warranty does not cover damage from power surges, water damage, accidents, cosmetic wear, or repairs made by anyone other than Quillon [1]. Additionally, Quillon Secure subscriptions are not covered by this policy [2].

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer:
The cost depends on which plan you choose, as prices are in US dollars [1].

*   **Secure Basic**: $4.99 per month [1].
*   **Secure Plus**: $9.99 per month [1].
*   **Secure Family**: $14.99 per month [1].

Prices for other countries are shown in the app at checkout, and annual billing costs the same as 10 months (giving you 2 months free) [1]. Additionally, every new Q3 router includes a 30-day free trial of Secure Plus [5].

questions.question: What does the error code mean?
questions.answer:
The specific meaning of an error code depends on which code you are seeing, as different codes indicate different problems [1].

*   **C-12** means the camera does not recognize the microSD card; use a card of 256 GB or less formatted as exFAT [4].
*   **C-31** means the camera could not upload a recording to the cloud; check that the camera is online and your Quillon Secure plan includes cloud recording [4].
*   **C-44** means the camera is too far from the router; move the camera or add a satellite node nearby [4].
*   **E-101** means no WAN cable is detected; ensure the Ethernet cable is plugged into the yellow WAN port, not a grey LAN port [5].
*   **E-102** means internet login failed due to incorrect PPPoE credentials; re-enter the username and password from your provider [5].
*   **E-204** means the router did not receive an IP address from the modem; restart the modem, wait two minutes, then restart the router [5].
*   **E-310** means a satellite node lost its connection to the router; move the node closer and wait five minutes for it to reconnect [5].
*   **E-4012** means the cooling fan has stopped; turn the router off and contact support for a replacement under warranty [5].
*   **E-5020** means the power supply is overheating; unplug the router for one hour and ensure vents are not covered [5].
*   **E-7001** means a firmware update failed its integrity check; the router will retry the update after 30 minutes, or contact support if it fails three times in a row [5].

If you see a flashing red light on your device, it indicates a hardware fault or a failed firmware update and you should check the error code in the app for more details [2].

questions.question: How many days do I have to return an unopened router for a full refund?
questions.answer: You have 30 days to return an unopened Quillon product for a full refund [1]. However, the documents also state that you can return any Quillon product within 60 days for a full refund [3]. The specific policy regarding routers is not detailed in the provided passages.

questions.question: How long does it take to get my refund?
questions.answer: Refunds can take up to 14 business days to appear on your statement [1]. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned product [2]. You will receive an email when the refund is issued [2].

questions.question: What are your phone support hours?
questions.answer: Phone support is available Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern Time [1]. However, other sources state that phone support is available Monday to Saturday, 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern Time [2]. There is a discrepancy between these two documents regarding the specific hours and days of availability.

questions.question: How many devices can connect to the guest network at the same time?
questions.answer: According to the Help Center FAQ, up to 16 devices can be connected to the guest network at once [1]. However, the Quillon Q3 Mesh Router Setup Guide states that up to 32 devices can use the guest network at the same time [2]. There is a discrepancy between these two documents regarding the specific limit for the Q3 router.

questions.question: What time do automatic firmware updates install on the Q3?
questions.answer: There are conflicting times stated in the documents regarding when automatic firmware updates install on the Q3. One document states that updates install between 2 a.m. and 4 a.m. local time [2], while another states they install between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. local time [1]. Additionally, one document notes that updates can be postponed for up to 7 days in the app [1].

questions.question: How many days of cloud video history does Secure Plus keep?
questions.answer: Secure Plus keeps 14 days of cloud video history [2]. However, the documents state that Secure Family offers 60 days of cloud video history [1], and this information is not available for other plans.

questions.question: Can I return a router I bought from a third-party retailer to Quillon?
questions.answer: The documents do not cover returns for products purchased from third-party retailers. They only state that you can return unopened Quillon products within 30 days of delivery [2].

questions.question: How long does the QC2 keep recordings on the microSD card before overwriting them?
questions.answer: The provided documents do not state how long recordings are kept on the microSD card before overwriting; they only mention that the camera can record to a 256 GB card [1]. The text notes that with a Quillon Secure Plus plan, cloud recordings are kept for 14 days [1], but it does not specify the retention period for local microSD storage.

questions.question: Which internet providers use PPPoE?
questions.answer: The provided documents do not specify which internet providers use PPPoE. They only state that if an internet provider uses PPPoE and rejects the username or password, you should re-enter those credentials under Settings, then Internet [1].
